body.message:
Wa alaikum assalam! Yes, the 1BR at Orchid Creek Beach is available from April 10. That's a 5-month stay, so just to set expectations, our rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks. The current rate is AED 7,000/month, all-inclusive, covering water, electricity, and internet. We can lock that in for the first 3 months, and for the remaining period the rate will depend on the season at that point.
Want me to get the details sorted for you?
